suggestions: With this many tasks, pca-entropy (data-driven weights) could rank tasks against each other. It is planned for v2 and gives dataset-relative scores.
Accessibility data is present: report it as a separate pass/fail gate next to SUM, not blended into it (SUMA has no validated formula yet).
reading: Scores are percentages: 50% means exactly on target, above 50% better than the target, below 50% worse. Completion without a required rate, and the share of actions without mistakes, are plain shares with no target.
